Ch3: 함정 구간 전수 보존 — 장인 이드로(미디안 제사장)·호렙산, 타지 않는 떨기나무, 신 벗기·거룩한 땅, I-AM-WHO-I-AM, 젖과 꿀이 흐르는 땅, 6개 민족(가나안·헷·아모리·브리스·히위·여부스), 사흘 길 예배 요청, 은·금·보석·여벌 옷 요구, 이 산에서의 예배 약속
paragraphs: Moses was out shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. He led the sheep to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God. That's when the angel of God showed up — in flames of fire blazing out of the middle of a bush! Moses looked closer. The bush was on fire but it wasn't burning up.
Moses said, "Whoa, what's going on here? This is wild! Why isn't the bush burning up?"
God saw that Moses had stopped to check it out. God called to him from inside the bush, "Moses! Moses!" Moses answered, "Yes? I'm right here!"
God said, "Don't come any closer. Take off your sandals — you're standing on holy ground."
Then he said, "I am the God of your father — the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, the God of Jacob." Moses covered his face, terrified to look at God.

God said, "I've been watching my people's suffering in Egypt for a long time. I've heard them crying out to escape their slave drivers — I know exactly how much pain they're in. So I've come down to rescue them, to rip them out of Egypt's grip and bring them out of that country to a good land with wide-open spaces — a land flowing with milk and honey. Right now it belongs to the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites."

"The Israelites' cry for help has reached me, and I've seen with my own eyes how brutally the Egyptians are treating them. So it's time for you to head back — I'm sending you to Pharaoh to bring my people, the Israelites, out of Egypt."
Moses said to God, "But why me? What makes you think I could ever march up to Pharaoh and lead the Israelites out of Egypt?"
"I'll be with you," God said. "And here's your proof that I'm the one sending you: once you've brought my people out of Egypt, you'll worship God right here on this very mountain."
Then Moses said to God, "OK, so I go to the Israelites and tell them, 'The God of your ancestors sent me' — and they ask, 'What's his name?' What do I tell them?"
God said to Moses, "I-AM-WHO-I-AM. Tell the Israelites: I-AM sent me to you."

God kept going: "Here's exactly what to tell the Israelites: 'God — the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, the God of Jacob — sent me to you.' This has always been my name, and it's how I'll always be known."

"Now get moving. Gather Israel's leaders and tell them: 'God — the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob — appeared to me and said: I've been paying attention to what's happening to you in Egypt, and I've decided to pull you out of your misery in Egypt and take you to the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites — a land overflowing with milk and honey.'"

"Trust me, they'll listen to you. Then you and Israel's leaders will go to Egypt's king and say: 'God, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Let us take a three-day trip into the wilderness to worship God — our God.'"

"I know Egypt's king won't let you go unless he's forced — so I'll step in and hit Egypt where it really hurts. My miracles are going to leave them reeling! After that, they'll be more than happy to let you go. And I'll make sure the Egyptians treat you generously on your way out — you won't leave empty-handed! Every woman will ask her neighbor and any guests staying in her house for silver and gold items, jewelry, and extra clothes — you'll dress your sons and daughters in them. You're going to clean the Egyptians out!"
title: The Burning Bush
